caption: The drawing depicts an ornamental metal object resembling a staff or flagpole, drawn vertically and centered on a plain background. The pole itself is dark in color, possibly a dark brown or black, with a decorative gold or brass finial at the top shaped like a bulb with a small metallic point. Attached near the upper section is a gold-toned, square flag or plaque featuring an ornate edge and symmetrical floral-like extensions on the top and bottom sides, with an intricate filigree pattern on the outer right edge. The surface of the flag is engraved with the year "1673" in white. Below the flag, the pole is adorned with two large, symmetrical scrollwork decorations on either side, made of curled metal in a dark shade matching the pole, and a smaller curled element below. The background is off-white with slight discoloration or faint marks in several places, but it remains clear and does not distract from the central object.
title: Weather Vane
